# FMC Media PC 0.3.7

- Stremio account: sign in under Settings → Stremio to link devices through your Library, resume position and watched marks. The first sync saves a backup of your Stremio library on this PC. Add-ons are not touched. The TV app does not use it yet.
- New Stats page: time watched, episodes, movies, streaks, time per month, top genres and most watched titles.
- New episode alerts: a small notice when a Library title gets a new episode. Turn it off under Settings → General → Notifications.
- Top 10 is one tidy row with names, year and rating. A wide window shows all ten; a smaller one scrolls with arrows.
- Discover and Anime open at once from their last saved page, then refresh. Discover no longer loads full title pages before showing anything.
- Season menu inside titles, with each season's year and episode count. Seasons that have their own page, such as Cyberpunk: Edgerunners and Edgerunners 2, now link to each other.
- Related now sits above More like this.
- Subtitles panel: Subtitle and Second subtitle are two rows that open a list grouped by language. A second subtitle now keeps its top and middle positions.

Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Activation, library and watch progress are preserved. Windows x64.
